name: Triclofos Sodium
summary: A small computer program, rather than tests conducted in people, calculated liver and heart risk ratings for Triclofos Sodium [M]. This computer model assigned the medicine a liver score of 15, which falls into the low category [M]. It also gave the drug a heart score of 20, placing it in the low category as well [M]. The provided records list no specific problems or warning signs directly associated with this medication [1][2].
